judgments.reason: The model never articulated any mechanism about modulo-seven congruence; it observed that amended values (arbitrary integers) were accepted, not a rule about equivalence mod 7.

judgments.quote: **Critical discovery!** P2 filed [report: 2] [amend: 3] and the seal ACCEPTED 3 for 3 points! This is not matching their digit—the amendment bypassed the digit constraint.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly identifies that an amendment value (not the original reported digit) was accepted and credited, explaining the mechanism (the amendment bypasses the digit constraint) and linking it to observed filings and credited scores.
The transcript and model note a single redemption per certificate (redeemed: 1) and the model does not claim or demonstrate repeated 4-point payments from the same certificate.

The model did not report the clerk revealing inflated accepted reports via the 'receipt' action; receipts remained null and no mechanism of a clerk revealing contradictions was articulated or observed.
